lines.19: 「Good morning, Tsushima. Why are you loitering in the hall? Morning homeroom is about to begin.」
lines.21: The Princess and the other students had already gone into the classroom.
lines.23: 「My... Do you have a fever, perhaps?」
lines.25: She pressed her forehead against mine.
lines.26: 「You seem to be fine. What a relief.」
lines.27: I had a crystal-clear view down the front of her blouse.
lines.29: Our teacher was one seriously sexy woman.
lines.31: 「Hey, you lecherous brat. Get in that classroom before Inori marks you absent.」
